metadata_validation.scope_note: Downloaded metadata supplies image identities and ports, not execution approval. Evidence source_digest is not treated as the final published_image digest; its relation is not independently assessed here.

source_comparison.scope_note: Scoped git diff compares the challenge tree only. The candidate still declares its original source SHA; this does not claim a build at the newer baseline or verify shared build infrastructure, signatures, image configuration or reproducibility.

capacity_observation.scope_note: Necessary allocatable bounds only; current requests, placement, runtime overhead, execution compatibility and live readiness are not proven.

author_defined_contract.local_compose_exception: Separate runner/platform-test/checker/e2e services are local tooling, not info.yaml production containers. External runner mode requires a separately approved Unix-socket deployment; its local runner has network_mode none.

candidate_runtime_mapping.inferred_boundary: Exact-host platform egress is a candidate platform restriction; no extra network container or runner TCP edge is inferred from local Compose.
candidate_runtime_mapping.execution_blocker: The official bundled supervisor must start as root and retain required capabilities before dropping HTTP children to UID/GID 10001. A blanket STANDARD nonroot policy breaks startup. A network policy cannot authorize this execution exception.

operator_inputs.description: Explicitly approve a compatible isolated bundled execution path or a separately designed external Unix-socket runner deployment; do not broaden shared-node privileges.
Published final service image candidate is recorded; verify provenance and image configuration and resolve the separately blocked supervisor execution approval.
Actual KOTH_PLATFORM_BASE_URL, exact destination host addresses, TCP port and drift handling.
Current approved release references, required authentication/session keys, challenge UUID and public origin; no secret values stored here.
Persistent SQLite/submission/replay paths, correct ownership, runner socket group, required capabilities, PID budget and RLIMIT_NOFILE hard limit at least 8192.

The declared 6000m CPU profile exceeds both observed single-node targets. Supply an approved target with sufficient schedulable CPU/memory/storage; do not lower the source profile without challenge approval.

activation_requirements: Supply an approved target with sufficient schedulable resources; the declared 6000m CPU profile exceeds both observed targets.
Resolve the root-supervisor incompatibility before creating any active Runtime graph or image entry.
Preserve bundled mode unless a separately reviewed external runner deployment is chosen; do not add local test/stub containers to production.
Verify startup privilege transitions, runner isolation/readiness, official scheduler and submissions, real platform authentication/team listing, scoring and restart recovery.
Prove exact-host egress succeeds and other destinations remain denied in the approved execution environment.
Approve actual images and current Backend Secret bindings separately from the candidate network mapping.
